# The voice environment, pinned to what is known to work on this box.
#
# torch and torchaudio are NOT listed here: setup.sh installs them first from
# https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu128, because the RTX 5090s are Blackwell
# (compute capability 12.0) and only the CUDA 12.8 wheels drive them. The
# nvidia-* and triton packages come in with that install.
#
# transformers 5.17.0 matters specifically: transformers.models.vibevoice lands
# there, which is what makes VibeVoice a first-class model here rather than a
# GitHub repo to reconstruct (Microsoft withdrew the original inference code).
